buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any.

3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Working of Railways is 24x7, hence driver may be called at any time in emergent situation. Con tractor must ensure availability of driver whenever they are called. Necessary charges like night running, extra KM running, extra hours running will be additionally as per GeM SLA. 2. The vehicle should be available for any outstation duty during the contract period. The toll charg es and other taxes for the outstation duty will be borne by the contractor. On production of toll receipt: th e amount will be reimbursed by railways. 3. The vehicle to be parked at officers/user’s premises or office premises based on the instruction o f the user. 4. It should be stipulated that the vehicle to be supplied should be registered as a commercial vehi cle with transport authority. It should have valid-insurance and should meet requirements of pollution sta ndard etc .as per provisions of Motor Vehicle Act and fulfill any other statutory obligations as applicable. Dr iver should possess as valid commercial driving license 5. The vehicle should be mechanically sound and shall be maintained decently with neat and clean interiors. The driver should possess good behavior and be neatly dressed. 6 It should also be stipulated that the agency participating in the tender should be registered unde r GST Act if applicable as per act and furnish valid GSTIN. 7 Contractor should fulfil all statutory requirements with respect to labour laws like minimum wag e to driver, PF, ESI, etc. He/ She will bear all liability in terms of Workman Compensation Act in case of acc idents/injury of his employee. 8 Contractor shall be fully responsible for any repair, accident, loss, damage to the vehicle and dri ver. 9. It shall be stipulated in the tender/ agreement that the vehicle contract can be short closed with one month notice, if the post of the officer is surrendered or the officer opts for drawl of transport allowan ce or due to unsatisfactory performance. As such, the following should be included in the tender: 10 For the purpose of extra payment on account of extra KM running of the vehicle, total KMs run by the vehicle for 3 months duration shall be considered. In case a vehicle is run for shorter KM in one mo nth and more KM in the next month, total KM will be clubbed. Such clubbing shall be done for 3 months pe riod starting from the next month of the date of L.O.A. For example if a vehicle is hired for stipulated 2500 KM per month, then additional payment for extra KM will be paid when total KM running of the vehicle is m ore than2500x3-7500 KM over a period of 3 months. Counting of such 3 months period will be starting fro m the next month of date of LOA. .
